```{r Libraries, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
```

```{r}
m <- read_rds("../models/cor_scaled/indicos_gaze_duration.rds")
mode <- "InDiCo"

pe <- brms::fixef(m, probs = c(.025, .975)) 
popeff <- pe["prev_len", "Estimate"]

ran <- ranef(m)
ran_subj <- ran[["subj_id"]]
# ran_subj
indi <- as.data.frame(ran_subj[, , 1:14]) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Estimate.c1:prev_len`, `Q2.5.c1:prev_len`, `Q97.5.c1:prev_len`,
                `Estimate.c2:prev_len`, `Q2.5.c2:prev_len`, `Q97.5.c2:prev_len`) %>%
  mutate(., across(dplyr::contains("prev_len"), ~ . + popeff)) %>%
  rename(spmu_len_c1 = `Estimate.c1:prev_len`,
                splo_len_c1 = `Q2.5.c1:prev_len`,
                spup_len_c1 = `Q97.5.c1:prev_len`,
                spmu_len_c2 = `Estimate.c2:prev_len`,
                splo_len_c2 = `Q2.5.c2:prev_len`,
                spup_len_c2 = `Q97.5.c2:prev_len`) %>%
  rownames_to_column("subj_id") %>%
  arrange(spmu_len_c1) %>%
  mutate(subject = factor(subj_id, levels = subj_id),
         mode = mode) %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, spmu_len_c1, splo_len_c1, spup_len_c1,
                          spmu_len_c2, splo_len_c2, spup_len_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("spmu_len_c1", "splo_len_c1", "spup_len_c1", "spmu_len_c2", "splo_len_c2", "spup_len_c2"),
    names_to   = c(".value", "contrast"),
    names_pattern = "(sp..)_len_(c[12])"
  ) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("c1", "c2"), labels = c("Session 1", "Session 2"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, contrast, spmu, splo, spup)

View(indi)

sum_indi <- indi %>%
  dplyr::group_by(contrast) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(spmu),
                   lq = mean(splo),
                   hq = mean(spup),
                   .groups = "drop")
sum_indi
```

```{r}
ggplot(indi, aes(x = spmu, xmin = splo, xmax = spup, y = subject, color = contrast)) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = sum_indi, aes(xintercept = mean, color = contrast), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(data = sum_indi, aes(xintercept = lq,   color = contrast), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(data = sum_indi, aes(xintercept = hq,   color = contrast), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(. ~ contrast) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Session 1" = "black", "Session 2" = "black")) +
  xlab("(a) Participant-level Word Length Spillover effect in InDiCo") +
  # xlab("") +
  ylab("Participant ID") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
    panel.background     = element_blank(),
    panel.border         = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.text           = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background     = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x      = unit(2, "pt"),
    axis.text.y          = element_text(size = 9),   # smaller y-axis tick labels
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10))  
  )

ggsave(filename = paste0("../visualization/paper/reliability/by-subject_indico_len.pdf"), width = 5, height = 8, dpi = 300
)
```

## Try colored plot
```{r}
m <- read_rds("../models/cor_scaled/indicos_gaze_duration.rds")

evidence_colors <- c(
  "Negative: 95%" = "#9C2F00",  # dark vermillion
  "Negative: 89%" = "#E66101",  # medium vermillion
  "Other"         = "#737373",  # neutral grey
  "Positive: 89%" = "#2389B9",  # medium blue
  "Positive: 95%" = "#005A8D"   # dark blue
)

plot_individual_effect <- function(model, term, effect_label, panel_label, filename) {
  probs <- c(.025, .055, .945, .975)
  population_effect <- brms::fixef(model, probs = probs)[term, "Estimate"]
  subject_effects <- brms::ranef(model, probs = probs)[["subj_id"]]
  subject_ids <- dimnames(subject_effects)[[1]]
  plot_df <- map_dfr(
    c("c1", "c2"),
    function(con) {
      coef_name <- paste0(con, ":", term)
      tibble(
        subject = subject_ids,
        contrast = con,
        spmu = subject_effects[, "Estimate", coef_name] + population_effect,
        splo95 = subject_effects[, "Q2.5", coef_name] + population_effect,
        splo89 = subject_effects[, "Q5.5", coef_name] + population_effect,
        spup89 = subject_effects[, "Q94.5", coef_name] + population_effect,
        spup95 = subject_effects[, "Q97.5",coef_name] + population_effect)}) %>%
    mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("c1", "c2"), labels = c("Session 1", "Session 2")), 
           evidence = case_when(spup95 < 0 ~ "Negative: 95%", spup89 < 0 ~ "Negative: 89%", splo95 > 0 ~ "Positive: 95%", splo89 > 0 ~ "Positive: 89%", TRUE ~ "Other"),
           evidence = factor(evidence, levels = names(evidence_colors)))
  subject_order <- plot_df %>% filter(contrast == "Session 1") %>% arrange(spmu) %>% pull(subject)
  
  plot_df <- plot_df %>% mutate(subject = factor(subject, levels = subject_order))
  summary_df <- plot_df %>% group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(spmu, na.rm = TRUE), lq= mean(splo95, na.rm = TRUE), 
              hq = mean(spup95, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = spmu, xmin = splo95, xmax = spup95, y = subject, color = evidence)) +
    geom_errorbarh(height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey25", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(data = summary_df, aes(xintercept = mean), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(data = summary_df, aes(xintercept = lq), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(data = summary_df, aes(xintercept = hq), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(. ~ contrast) +
    scale_color_manual(values = evidence_colors, drop = FALSE,
                       labels = c("Negative, 95% interval excludes zero",
                                  "Negative, 89% interval excludes zero",
                                  "Interval includes zero",
                                  "Positive, 89% interval excludes zero",
                                  "Positive, 95% interval excludes zero")) +
    labs(x = paste0("(", panel_label, ") Participant-level ", effect_label, " Spillover effect in InDiCo"), y = "Participant ID", color = NULL) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey85"),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey90"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
          panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "pt"), 
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)))

  ggsave(filename, p, width = 5.5, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  p
}
```

```{r}
p_len <- plot_individual_effect(
  model = m,
  term = "prev_len",
  effect_label = "Word Length",
  panel_label = "a",
  filename = paste0("../visualization/paper/reliability/", "by-subject_indico_len_colored.pdf"))

p_surp <- plot_individual_effect(
  model = m,
  term = "prev_surp",
  effect_label = "Surprisal",
  panel_label = "b",
  filename = paste0("../visualization/paper/reliability/", "by-subject_indico_surp_colored.pdf"))

p_len
p_surp
```
